definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese side dish where vegetables (and sometimes other ingredients) are mixed with a creamy dressing made from mashed tofu, sesame, miso, sugar, and soy sauce. A common item in home cooking and traditional set meals.

examples.japanese: ほうれん{草|そう}の{白和|しらあ}えを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made spinach dressed with tofu.

examples.japanese: {白和|しらあ}えは{豆腐|とうふ}をすり{潰|つぶ}して{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Shira-ae is made by mashing tofu.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}が{作|つく}る{白和|しらあ}えは{胡麻|ごま}がたっぷり{入|はい}っていて{本当|ほんとう}においしい。
examples.english: My grandmother's shira-ae has lots of sesame in it and is truly delicious.

notes:
USAGE: {白和|しらあ}え is a standard dish in Japanese home cooking ({家庭|かてい}{料理|りょうり}). The name comes from {白|しろ} (white, referring to the tofu) and {和|あ}える (to dress/mix). Common vegetables used include ほうれん{草|そう} (spinach), {春菊|しゅんぎく} (garland chrysanthemum), こんにゃく, and {人参|にんじん} (carrot).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ほうれん{草|そう}の{白和|しらあ}え: spinach dressed with tofu
- {白和|しらあ}えの{衣|ころも}: the tofu dressing
- {白和|しらあ}えを{作|つく}る: to make shira-ae
